title: PlaceListDetail
description: A saved collection with its places (T-062) — GET /api/v1/me/lists/{id}, the add/remove responses, and the public read GET /api/v1/lists/{public_slug} (T-063). Each item carries the owner's note + position plus a map-ready place summary, so a client can render the list and drop its pins without a second query.

owner.description: Present only when the owner was eager-loaded (the public read); null when their profile is private — a private user sharing a list must not leak their identity.
